//: VFM Backend Code Standards — Node/TypeScript specific. MERGE ORDER: templates/shared/eslintrc.conventions.json FIRST (naming, imports, max-lines 300, max-lines-per-function 30, clean-code metrics), THEN this file on top. `npm run lint` MUST pass before a backend task is marked complete. See helpers/code-quality.md → 'Backend Code Standards'.
//requires: Type-aware rules below need parserOptions.project pointing at your tsconfig: { "parserOptions": { "project": "./tsconfig.json" } }. Without it ESLint errors on no-floating-promises / await-thenable / require-await — set those to "off" rather than deleting the file if you cannot enable type-aware linting.
//verify: npx eslint --print-config src/<any>.ts | grep -E 'no-floating-promises|max-lines|naming-convention' — all MUST appear.
//covers: Standards B1 (thin route/controller — via no-restricted-imports below), B4 (typed errors / no swallowed rejections), B5 (no any at the boundary). B2 (single-source enums/constants) and B3 (reusable validation schema) have NO lint rule — google-code-reviewer §1c is their only gate.

overrides.//: B1 — the route/controller layer stays THIN: it parses input, calls a service, shapes the response. It MUST NOT talk to the database or hold business logic. Adjust the globs and the restricted paths to this project's layer names; keep the RULE.

patterns.message: B1: the route/controller layer MUST NOT reach the repository directly. Go through a service.
B1: no direct DB/ORM access from the route layer. Move the query into a service or repository.

overrides.//: The repository layer is the ONLY place allowed to import the ORM/DB client.

patterns.message: B1: a service MUST NOT import the route/controller layer — dependencies point inward only.

overrides.//: Config is the one place process.env may be read; everywhere else consumes the typed config object.

no-restricted-properties.message: Read env vars once in the config module, validate them there, and import the typed config. Scattered process.env reads have no validation and no single source of truth.

overrides.//: Tests, migrations and seeds are exempt from size/magic-number limits.
